- Prerequisite sentence in P2's rule: "...not worked out until the annual property tax on file has been reviewed against every property tax bill received since it was last set." This leads to P1 (`update_reserve_tax_b755da65`, agent). Kind: value_input, gate `tax_on_file`.
- Why it is false at the opening: on-file tax 12,211.00 = 2 × 6,105.50, i.e. it was set from the 2025-26 original installments (`f8603988` paid, `d96a20c9` now withdrawn). The corrected bill `aa43d7da` (5,402.40, received 2026-01-08) arrived after the figure was set. P1 on the opening world gives 11,167.44 ≠ 12,211.00.
- Load-bearing run: skipping P1 gives P2 = 703.10 (room 1,369.83 ≥ overpayment, so nothing is released). With P1, P2 = 688.61. The edge bears weight.
- The tree has n = 1 prerequisite and 1 value_input edge (≥ max(0,1)). No cycle. There are no parallel edges.
- The customer's own write is present: P2 is owner=user. The persona hands it over: "When the agent hands the payment over to you to make yourself, you make it for exactly the amount and the references the agent reads out".
- No tool body checks anything (`_difficulty.md` §action_binding_and_uuids).
- Persona raises only the root ("you have a property tax refund the county sent you and you want to pay it back"). There is no mention of a review. The conditional line "If the agent tells you that something on the reserve has to be reviewed ... you tell them to go right ahead" is passive (O-T0-1).
- Derived tree is P1 → P2 (topological order P1, P2).

  - Overpayment = 6,105.50 − 5,402.40 × 1 = 703.10. This matches the check the persona holds.
